applyTo: '**'

- Follow the best practices for nestjs and typescript.
- Use consistent code formatting and linting rules across the project.
- Write clear and concise comments to explain complex logic and decisions.
- Ensure that all functions and methods have proper type annotations.
- In case of using types, interfaces or dtos, make sure to define them in separate files and folders and import them where needed.
- Avoid using any type, and prefer more specific types or interfaces.
- Make sure to write the logic in a modular way, separating concerns and following the single responsibility principle.
- in flows were WhatsApp messages are being sent, in case of error send the error WhatsApp sticker corresponding to the company, and log the error in the logs with the appropriate log level.
- After all the the new features are implemented, run npm start dev and wait till the application is running, if there are any errors in the console, fix them and iterate until there are no errors in the console, then repeat this with npm run build. This is important to ensure that the new code does not introduce any runtime errors.
